latest_release.name: v26.6.0
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

- **Security:** postdetails and alert-log uploads now mask beta passwords, tokens and API keys ([#5182](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5182)).
- **Updates:** Source servers now update when they request a restart; FiveM, Luanti and OpenRA force downloads instead of reusing stale files; and GoldSrc re-validates shared content ([#5178](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5178), [#5180](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5180), [#5162](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5162)).
- **GSLT:** Counter-Strike 2, Empires and Zombie Panic! Source now receive the configured token ([#5107](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5107), [#5201](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5201)).
- **Server reliability:** start failures from missing libraries are fixed across several games, and Eco and SCP: Secret Laboratory receive their required runtime dependencies ([#5164](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5164), [#5156](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5156)).

## Changes to existing behaviour

These apply automatically.

- **Support removal:** Onset and BATTALION: Legacy are no longer supported ([#5195](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5195)).
- **Configuration:** Chivalry: Medieval Warfare and Ballistic Overkill now apply the LinuxGSM-managed settings on the next start. Move any direct edits to their game-owned configuration copies into `PCServer-UDKGame.ini` and `boserver.txt` respectively ([#5174](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5174), [#5158](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5158)).
- The Update Check workflow now validates its intended install and update paths without an invalid pre-install diagnostic ([#5203](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5203)).

## Game server fixes

- Query and configuration fixes for Barotrauma, Avorion, Minecraft Bedrock, Stationeers, Jedi Knight II, Chivalry: Medieval Warfare, Medal of Honor: Allied Assault and Ballistic Overkill ([#5177](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5177), [#5176](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5176), [#5170](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5170), [#5168](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5168), [#5166](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5166), [#5174](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5174), [#5172](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5172), [#5158](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5158)).
- Insurgency now launches `srcds_run` on Ubuntu, and The Front receives its friendly-fire setting ([#5154](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5154), [#5186](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5186)).
## Other fixes

- **Core checks:** failed checks now return a non-zero status even before logging is initialized ([#5194](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5194), [#5192](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5192)).
- **Installation:** default configuration source directories are standardized, and the post-install command is identified clearly ([#5036](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5036), [#5199](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5199)).
- **Usage statistics:** anonymous reports now go to the LinuxGSM Cloudflare-backed usage collector instead of Google Analytics. The opt-in setting is unchanged ([#5198](https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5198)).

## What's Changed
* fix(dys): add 32-bit libcurl dependency by @dgibbs64 in https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5160
* fix(deps): add ICU runtime for eco and scpsl by @dgibbs64 in https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGSM/pull/5156
* fix(boserver): apply boserver.txt by copying it to config.txt by @dgibbs64 in https://github.com/GameServerManagers/LinuxGS
